stdcells release (lib.lock), with zero foundry cells of any kind.
Ported from stdcells harden/config.json at tag lib-v1.0 — the
settings below are that repo's hard-won ones, not fresh guesses.
Synthesis already happened in flow/make_hardening.py; CI does P&R
only, so the netlist that gets audited is the netlist that ships.
SIGNOFF-ONLY SDC (READINESS.md M6). Gives STA the ring-oscillator
clock domain so the prescaler - an 8-bit counter clocked directly by
the ring at a predicted 914 MHz - is actually timed. Until 2026-08-02
there was no SDC at all and that counter had never been checked.
*** DO NOT ALSO SET THIS AS PNR_SDC_FILE. *** If CTS sees ro_clk as a
clock it builds a clock tree on it, i.e. buffers on the ring nodes -
the H3 defect arriving by another road. See the header of the file.
lib-v1.1 corner-aware re-pin: one timing view PER CORNER (ported from
stdcells at lib-v1.1). LIB is the corner-keyed variable; the sky130A
PDK's 9 corners = {nom,min,max} x these three patterns. hd libs ride
along per corner because the flow still loads hd views. EXTRA_LIBS keeps
the nominal view ONLY so yosys elaborate can blackbox our cells;
flow/check_corner_spread.py asserts in CI that the SDF corners differ,
which catches a nominal view silently overriding LIB.
EXTRA_LIBS IS LOAD-BEARING AND ALSO CAUSES M10. Measured 2026-08-02:
removing it fails yosys elaborate with a NOR2_X1 module-not-found
module ...` (run 30754622184), so it really is what lets elaborate
blackbox our cells. But own_hardening.lib is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the tt
corner view (sha 8389b657, lib.lock) and LibreLane loads EXTRA_LIBS into
EVERY timing corner, so it also hands tt timing to ff and ss: at signoff
ff agrees with tt on 99.8% of arcs though the liberty says it should be
up to 5673% faster. The timing signoff is therefore single-PVT wearing
three labels. DO NOT just delete this line - the fix is to give elaborate
a liberty that is not also a timing view, or to scope it to synthesis.
flow/check_corner_spread.py measures the result; READINESS.md M10.
NO EXTRA_LIBS - removed 2026-08-02 (READINESS.md M10). own_hardening.lib
is byte-identical to the tt corner view (sha 8389b657, lib.lock), and
LibreLane loads EXTRA_LIBS into EVERY timing corner, so keeping it here
handed tt timing to ff and ss alike and made the whole signoff single-PVT.
An earlier removal failed at yosys elaborate (Module NOR2_X1 referenced,
run 30754622184) because EXTRA_LIBS was also what let elaborate blackbox
the own cells. CELL_VERILOG_MODELS now does that job instead - yosys.py
and pyosys.py run it through create_blackbox_model() - and unlike
EXTRA_LIBS it is invisible to OpenSTA, so the corner-keyed LIB above is
left as the only timing source. flow/check_corner_spread.py measures it.
TT 1x2 tile. A 1x1 was tried first and MEASURED impossible, not
merely tight: global placement reported utilization 108.5% (GPL-0301)
before a single clock buffer or hold fix was inserted. 14094 um2 of
logic does not fit a ~13000 um2 core, and no density knob changes that.
Core margins: librelane's defaults eat ~25% of a 1x1 (site HEIGHTS
of 10.9um each). 1/1/2/2 was the lever that won the stdcells 1x1.
A fast library makes hold OVERFIX expensive: default margins x a
171ps BUF_X2 produced 322 repair buffers = 27% of logic area and an
infeasible placement. 0.005 was the measured working value -- tuned
when the DFF hold REQUIREMENT was the literal 0.0, which is M17.
lib-v1.6 measured it (+12.146 ps for a rising D at ff) and this bare
die went +5.17 ps -> -7.62 ps at min_ff. Raised to 0.030 in step with
src/config.json, where the full reasoning is written down; the two
must not drift apart, because this build is the one that can be
debugged locally while src/ is the one that ships.
THE zero-foundry lever: without this, the flow quietly inserts hd
tie cells, hold buffers, CTS buffers and fill, and the claim dies.
0.05 here was DRIFT, found 2026-08-20 while closing M17. src/config.json
halved this to 0.025 when M12 was fixed -- TritonCTS was given -max_cap
5e-14 and still landed at 0.1157, so the budget it PLANS against is the
only lever -- and the halving was never propagated to this build. The
consequence showed up as hold: at twice the cap budget CTS builds a
coarser tree, and on the failing path the capture clock landed 253 ps
after the launch clock while the data took 256 ps. With lib-v1.6's real
+12.146 ps hold requirement at ff that is a violation, and hold repair
could not close it: WNS pinned at exactly -0.017 on _4935_/D from
iteration 250 to the end while it kept inserting buffers, at BOTH
hold-margin 0.005 and 0.030. The submitted build, which already had
0.025, converged at margin 0.030 with no RSZ-0064 and closed at
+41.45 ps. Same design, same margin, different clock tree. Two configs
that disagree about the same physical question is the defect; the
number is just where it surfaced.
Signoff is the official KLayout deck, run as its own CI step (see
harden.yml). magic's CIF read of GDS-only custom cells emits tens of
thousands of phantom errors, and netgen LVS rides on that same
extraction — cell-level LVS was done in stdcells against the PDK deck.
